verdicts.reason: A breaks up the copy: the subline sits far below the shoe, cut off from its headline, and the LIMITED badge floats at the far right, not lined up with the Enter Now button, leaving large dead bands between scattered pieces. B keeps the headline and subline together and puts the CTA and badge on one shared left edge, so it reads in order from top to bottom, but the headline and CTA are undersized for a 432×768 story and the empty bands above the headline and below the shoe make it feel sparse.
